hero.title: UNLOCK: Create Beyond Boundaries
hero.subtitle: The AI & Young Professionals Summit & Innovation Challenge

about.summary: UNLOCK is an AI workplace innovation challenge and grand expo run with iCEP at UiTM Shah Alam. Ten teams (five University Student teams and five Young Professional teams) join a 3-week virtual incubation sprint, then showcase working prototypes at the physical UNLOCK Summit on 7 December 2026.
objectives: EDIT: Build practical applied-AI skills for students and young professionals
EDIT: Turn workplace problems into working AI prototypes
EDIT: Connect young talent with industry

prepare: Team leader's full name, email and WhatsApp or phone number
Team name and the names of all 5 members
Proposed project title and a short description of the innovation
Confirmation that all members agree, agreement to the rules, and PDPA consent
steps: Team leader completes the Student or Professional form (once only)
You receive a confirmation email with your registration ID
Complete the member-confirmation form from that email
Join the WhatsApp group shown at the end of registration
Attend the Saturday sprint sessions and submit your deliverables

timeline.title: Registration Closes
timeline.detail: First come, first served. Only 5 team spots per category.

timeline.title: Week 1 Kickoff & Framing
timeline.detail: Virtual soft launch, Applied AI Literacy in the Workplace, Virtual Meet 1 on modern AI prototyping tools, task scenario draw, 1-page proposal kickoff.

timeline.title: Week 2 System Architecture
timeline.detail: Virtual Meet 2: turn problem statements into technical briefs, then wireframe system logic, user flows and interface models.

timeline.title: Week 3 Prototype & Selection
timeline.detail: Virtual Meet 3 on refinement and testing. Industry panels (including iCEP) evaluate all 10 prototypes. Top 3 Student and Top 3 Young Professional teams are chosen for the live pitch. All 10 teams advance to the exhibition.

timeline.title: Grand Finale & UNLOCK Summit
timeline.detail: Dewan Annex / Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam.

zones.d: Industry talk sessions, the live final pitch of the Top 6 teams (3 Student and 3 Young Professional), then the grand awards ceremony.
All 10 teams set up interactive project booths for delegates, industry visitors and evaluators.

summit.passportText: Visitors follow the UNLOCK Passport (Onboarding, Exploration, Redemption) to visit all 10 booths and redeem rewards.
summit.peoples: People's Choice Award: summit delegates vote directly across all 10 exhibition booths.

awards.label: Official Trophies
awards.d: Top 3 Student teams and Top 3 Young Professional teams

awards.label: Appreciation Hampers
awards.d: Top 6 teams plus the People's Choice winners

awards.label: Finalist Medals
awards.d: All 50 talents who complete the incubation and exhibition

submissions: Working AI prototype / proof of concept

items: Active university students (undergraduate and postgraduate) join the Student Category. Early-career working adults join the Young Professional Category.
Each participant joins one team and one industry track only.
Solve a realistic workplace challenge with applied AI inside one of the 6 tracks.
Show the problem, a working AI architecture, user workflows and measurable business impact.
Original design work. Disclose all third-party models, APIs and frameworks.
Not allowed: plagiarism, fabricated survey data, unverified system claims, private or confidential company data without clearance, malicious applications.
Projects must comply with the PDPA. No unencrypted personal records, credentials or proprietary databases.

Disqualified for: intellectual property infringement, not disclosing core AI-generated code, fabricated results, late delivery outside approved sprint windows, or unapproved absence from required checkpoints.
Professional conduct is required at all virtual workshops, mentor clinics and on-site summit venues.

faqs.a: Active Malaysian university students (undergraduate and postgraduate) join the Student Category, and early-career working adults join the Young Professional Category.
faqs.alt: If you are a university student (undergraduate or postgraduate), register in the Student Category. If you are an early-career working adult, register as a Young Professional.

faqs.a: Only the team leader registers, once, using the Student form or the Young Professional form in the Register section. Then confirm your members with the second form from your confirmation email, and join the WhatsApp group at the end.
faqs.alt: Choose the Student or Young Professional form in the Register section. The team leader fills it in once, then follows the confirmation email to confirm the members and join the WhatsApp group.

faqs.q: Should every team member fill in the registration form?
faqs.a: No. Only the team leader or an authorised representative fills in the main form, to avoid duplicate team records. Members complete the member-confirmation form later.
faqs.alt: No. One person per team (the leader or an authorised representative) submits the main form. Members only complete the second member-confirmation form.

faqs.kw: team size members pasukan how many spots
faqs.a: The cohort has 10 teams (50 talents): 5 Student teams and 5 Young Professional teams. Every team has exactly 5 members.
faqs.alt: There are 10 team places in total: 5 for students and 5 for young professionals. Each team must have exactly 5 people.

faqs.a: Customer Experience & Support, HR & Talent Operations, Operations & Productivity, Marketing & Content, Data & Decision-Making, and Sustainability & ESG. Each team picks one.
faqs.alt: Pick one of Customer Experience & Support, HR & Talent Operations, Operations & Productivity, Marketing & Content, Data & Decision-Making, or Sustainability & ESG.

faqs.kw: when date tarikh schedule timeline deadline
faqs.a: Registration closes on Monday 2 November 2026. The Saturday sprint sessions are on 7, 14 and 21 November, and the Grand Finale and UNLOCK Summit is on Monday 7 December 2026.
faqs.alt: Remember these dates: 2 Nov (registration closes), 7, 14 and 21 Nov (Saturday sprint sessions) and 7 Dec 2026 (Grand Finale and summit).

faqs.a: The Grand Finale is at Dewan Annex / Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam. The 3-week sprint is online.
faqs.alt: The 3-week sprint is online. The Grand Finale on 7 December is in person at Dewan Annex / Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam.

faqs.a: Week 1: kickoff, applied AI literacy and prototyping tools. Week 2: system architecture and wireframing. Week 3: prototype refinement and finalist selection.
faqs.alt: Week 1 is the kickoff and AI literacy, Week 2 covers system architecture and wireframes, and Week 3 is prototype testing and finalist selection.

faqs.a: Judges look at Innovation and Originality, AI Integration & Technical Soundness, Problem Relevance & Track Alignment, Feasibility & Practical Functionality, Scalability & Organizational Impact, Pitch Presentation & Prototype Demo, and Future Potential & Roadmap.
faqs.alt: Teams are assessed on seven areas: originality, AI and technical soundness, problem relevance, feasibility, scalability and impact, the pitch and demo, and future potential.

faqs.kw: prize award trophy hamper medal hadiah
faqs.a: 6 official trophies (Top 3 per category), 9 appreciation hampers (Top 6 teams plus People's Choice winners) and 50 commemorative finalist medals for every participant.
faqs.alt: Winners receive 6 trophies and 9 hampers (including People's Choice), and all 50 participants receive a commemorative finalist medal.

faqs.q: What do we have to submit?
faqs.a: A 1-page proposal, technical architecture and wireframes, a working AI prototype, a pitch deck (10-minute presentation, no Q&A), a booth setup for Zone B, and the AI-Use Declaration.
faqs.alt: Your submission pack has six parts: the 1-page proposal, architecture and wireframes, a working prototype, the pitch deck for a 10-minute talk, your Zone B booth setup, and the AI-Use Declaration.

faqs.a: An official form explaining which AI tools, models and APIs you used and how you prompted them. All third-party tools must be disclosed.
faqs.alt: It is an official form where you list every AI tool, model and API you used and describe how you prompted them.

faqs.q: Who pitches live at the finale?
faqs.a: The Top 3 Student teams and Top 3 Young Professional teams pitch live on the Main Stage (Zone A). All 10 teams exhibit at booths in Zone B.
faqs.alt: Six teams take the Main Stage in Zone A: the Top 3 Students and the Top 3 Young Professionals. All 10 teams still exhibit in Zone B.

faqs.a: An interactive visitor journey (Discover, Engage, Validate, Unlock) that takes delegates through all 10 team booths, with rewards to redeem.
faqs.alt: It is a visitor journey (Discover, Engage, Validate, Unlock) that guides delegates around all 10 booths so they can redeem rewards.

faqs.q: How does the People's Choice Award work?
faqs.a: Summit delegates vote directly across all 10 exhibition booths.
faqs.alt: Delegates at the summit vote at the 10 exhibition booths, and the most-voted team wins the People's Choice Award.

faqs.q: What is Zone A and Zone B?
faqs.a: Zone A is the Main Stage conference with talks, the final pitch and the awards. Zone B is the exhibition floor where all 10 teams run interactive booths.
faqs.alt: Zone A is the main stage for talks, the final pitches and the awards. Zone B is the exhibition floor with all 10 team booths.

faqs.q: Can I join more than one team?
faqs.a: No. Each participant joins one team and one track only.
faqs.alt: No. You can only be in one team and one track.

faqs.q: Can we use private company data?
faqs.a: Not without clearance. Projects must follow the PDPA, with no unencrypted personal records, credentials or proprietary databases.
faqs.alt: Only with clearance. Projects must follow the PDPA and must not use unencrypted personal records, credentials or proprietary databases.

faqs.a: IP infringement, not disclosing core AI-generated code, fabricated results, late delivery outside approved windows, or unapproved absence from required sprint checkpoints.
faqs.alt: Copying others' IP, hiding core AI-generated code, made-up results, late delivery outside approved windows, or missing required checkpoints without approval.

faqs.a: Registration fees, if any, are non-refundable.
faqs.alt: Any registration fee that applies is non-refundable.

faqs.q: How do I join the WhatsApp group?
faqs.a: The link is shown at the end of the registration form and is only for registered participants, so it is not posted on this website.
faqs.alt: Participants receive the WhatsApp group link when they finish registering, and official updates are also sent by email.

faqs.a: iCEP is the Anchor Industry Partner and Strategic Advisory Lead, and its industry panel helps evaluate the prototypes.
faqs.alt: iCEP is our anchor industry partner and strategic advisory lead, and its panel helps evaluate the prototypes.

faqs.q: Is there a Q&A after the pitch?
faqs.a: No. The summit pitch is a 10-minute presentation with no Q&A session.
faqs.alt: There is no Q&A at the summit. Each of the 6 finalist teams has a 10-minute presentation slot.

faqs.a: UiTM Shah Alam is the host, iCEP is the anchor industry partner and strategic advisory lead, and KrackedDevs, Malaysia's builder ecosystem, is a partner.
faqs.alt: Our partners are UiTM Shah Alam (host), iCEP (anchor industry partner) and KrackedDevs (Malaysia's builder ecosystem).

faqs.a: Follow us on Instagram and TikTok at @unlockai.project. The links are in the Contacts section.
faqs.alt: We are on Instagram and TikTok as @unlockai.project, with direct links in the Contacts section.
